body:
In the latest NIST guidelines periodic password change was removed.

If ASVS wants to follow this, 2.25 should be removed. It only makes sense for for periodic password change (or possibly also forced password change), but it currently looks a bit out of place, because nothing around it suggests any context.

comments.body: It's gone. We are in transition now, we really need to decompose all the requirements and distill them into the application and API specific ones. We are not aiming to add a ton of requirements for those implementing authenticators, federation, and relying parties, but the main issues relating to authentication by apps and APIs.

title: Drop 2.25?
